findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint uses OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by="-datetime", so self.key is "datetime" and getattr(item, self.key) returns a datetime.datetime. math.floor and math.ceil do not accept datetime values and raise TypeError, so any use of optimized pagination will fail with a 500. Additionally value_from_cursor returns cursor.value (an int) instead of converting it to a datetime like DateTimePaginator, so even if get_item_key were fixed, second-page cursors would compare a datetime column to an integer.

findings.title: Advanced negative-offset pagination uses unsupported negative QuerySet slicing
findings.body: When enable_advanced_features is true and cursor.offset is negative, start_offset is set to the negative cursor.offset and the code evaluates queryset[start_offset:stop]. Django QuerySet slicing raises ValueError for negative start/stop offsets ("Negative indexing is not supported"). A client can supply a negative cursor offset, causing the endpoint to return 500 instead of paginating.

findings.title: Redirect depth reduced from 10000 to 1000 can split deep span trees
findings.body: The redirect-following loop now stops after ~1000 hops instead of 10000. For span trees deeper than that, the script writes a redirect for the deepest processed span to an intermediate set rather than the true root, so the segment will be flushed in pieces with incorrect or duplicate segment IDs. The previous comment explicitly noted the 10k limit could already fail to join; lowering it to 1k makes that failure much more likely for deep traces.

findings.title: Eviction can drop the root span or other required spans before flush
findings.body: The new zpopmin eviction trims the sorted set to 1000 members by score, but it runs before has_root_span is recorded and does not protect the root span payload. When batch insertion pushes a segment above 1000 members, zpopmin may remove the root span (e.g., when timestamps are equal, as in the tests, or when timestamps are out of order), while the has_root_span flag may still be set. The flushed segment can then be marked as having a root span but contain no segment span, yielding incomplete trace data with no error or metric.
